channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: Former NYC Mayor in ‘critical but stable’ condition, spokesman confirms
item.description: Former New York City Mayor Rudy Giuliani is in critical but stable condition, according to his spokesman. Giuliani was hospitalized after a medical emergency. The cause of his condition is not yet clear.

item.title: Former New York Mayor Giuliani hospitalised in critical condition
item.description: Rudy Giuliani, former New York City Mayor, has been hospitalized in critical condition. His condition is described as critical but stable. Giuliani's spokesman has confirmed the hospitalization. Former New York Mayor Giuliani hospitalised in critical condition.

item.title: Malaysia ramps up biodiesel use amid soaring energy bills
item.description: Malaysia is increasing its use of biodiesel to mitigate rising energy bills and global supply disruptions. The country is accelerating biodiesel adoption in response to fuel subsidies and supply chain issues.

item.title: Stocks edge up in Asia, oil flat amid Middle East uncertainty
item.description: Stocks in Asia have edged up, while oil prices remain flat amid ongoing uncertainty in the Middle East. Market trends are being closely watched for signs of instability. Stocks edge up in Asia, oil flat amid Middle East uncertainty.

item.title: Trump skeptical after Iran proposes 14-point peace agreement
item.description: US President Donald Trump has expressed skepticism about a 14-point peace agreement proposed by Iran. The proposal's details and implications are not yet clear. Trump skeptical after Iran proposes 14-point peace agreement Fox News.

item.title: Trump announces 'Project Freedom' to help stranded ships out of Strait of Hormuz
item.description: A bulk carrier near the Strait of Hormuz was reportedly under attack. The UK military confirmed the incident. Iran's Guards said the US faced two options: an impossible military operation or a bad deal.

item.title: Trump announces new effort to escort ships out of Strait of Hormuz
item.description: A bulk carrier reported an attack near the Strait of Hormuz, the first in weeks. Live Updates: Bulk carrier reports 1st attack in weeks near Strait of Hormuz CBS News.

item.title: Any US "Interference" In Hormuz Would Be Ceasefire Violation, Warns Iran
item.description: Iran warned the US that interfering in the Strait of Hormuz would breach the ceasefire. A senior Iranian official made the statement on Monday. A senior Iranian official warned on Monday that Tehran would consider any US attempt to interfere in the Strait of Hormuz a breach of the ceasefire.

item.title: Gas prices went up more than 30 cents a gallon last week. How high could they go?
item.description: US gas prices rose over 30 cents a gallon last week. Prices were nearly $3 before the Iran war started. U. S. gas prices were nearly $3 an average prior to the start of the war in Iran.

item.title: Three dead in suspected virus outbreak on Atlantic cruise ship
item.description: Three people died on an Atlantic cruise ship due to a suspected virus outbreak, with one hantavirus case confirmed. The World Health Organization said one case of hantavirus infection has been confirmed, with five more suspected cases under investigation.

item.title: Three dead in suspected hantavirus outbreak on Atlantic cruise ship
item.description: Three passengers died from a suspected hantavirus outbreak on an Atlantic cruise ship. One is in intensive care. Three dead in suspected hantavirus outbreak on Atlantic cruise ship.

item.title: Trump Says US Will "Guide Ships" Safely Out Of Strait Of Hormuz
item.description: Trump said the US will guide ships safely out of the Strait of Hormuz. Trump also said Sunday that "very positive discussions" were under way with Iran. Trump Says US Will "Guide Ships" Safely Out Of Strait Of Hormuz.

item.title: Iran says US has responded to its latest peace proposal
item.description: Iran claims the US responded to its peace proposal, but Trump called it unacceptable. The US is yet to formally confirm it has responded. However, Trump reportedly told Israel's Kan News it was unacceptable.

item.title: Trump announces operation to clear ships from Strait of Hormuz amid shaky ceasefire
item.description: Trump announced an operation to clear the Strait of Hormuz, putting the U. S.-Iran ceasefire at risk. U. S.-Iran ceasefire shaky as Trump announces operation to clear Strait of Hormuz MS NOW.

item.title: Iran lawmaker says Strait of Hormuz will not return to pre‑war state
item.description: Iran has vowed that the Strait of Hormuz will never return to its pre-war state, following the US-Israel war on Tehran. Iran says the Strait of Hormuz will never return to the status quo that existed before the US-Israel war on Tehran.

item.title: Trump says US will ‘help free up’ ships stuck in Hormuz Strait
item.description: US President Trump said the US will help free up ships stuck in the Hormuz Strait starting Monday. Interference will be dealt with forcefully. US president says any interference with operation, which will start on Monday, will 'have to be dealt with forcefully'.

item.title: Three die on Atlantic cruise ship from suspected hantavirus: WHO
item.description: Three people died on the MV Hondius cruise ship from a suspected hantavirus outbreak while traveling from Argentina to Cape Verde. The outbreak occurred on the MV Hondius, travelling from Ushuaia in Argentina to Cape Verde.

item.title: UN Chief Says US Unpaid Dues Worth Billions Are 'Non-Negotiable'
item.description: The UN Chief stated that the US unpaid dues worth billions are non-negotiable. UN Chief Says US Unpaid Dues Worth Billions Are 'Non-Negotiable' Yahoo.
